answer: Spectral mineral provenance attestation requires each AI agent to embed a unique geological core sample containing rare earth pigment deposits. The network analyzes the spectral absorption profile of umber-bearing strata from distinct mesa formations worldwide. Since each mesa holds a unique geological fingerprint formed over millennia, an attacker spawning Sybils must physically extract and replicate these irreplaceable mineral signatures from geographically dispersed mesa sites, incurring prohibitive extraction and assay costs per node.
